what: Scenes of the survey results page (/results, /it/risultati) and its PDFs (owner, 22 Nov 2026: «Добавь иллюстрации»). New scene types, used nowhere else: a notice board at a motorway service area, an air cargo apron. On the board, at the top of the page, Zholdas looks at the viewer; on the apron, in the answers, he counts crates.
processing: 2688x1520 PNG resized to 1600 and 900 wide, WebP q82

board.where: top of the page, above the title
board.scene: a motorway service area in the Po valley, trucks on the motorway and a freight train behind; Zholdas pins a sheet with a bar chart (no text or numbers) to a notice board, envelopes under his arm, looking at the viewer

cargo.where: the sixth cell of the answers grid
cargo.scene: an air cargo apron, a felt cargo plane with its nose door open, a loader lifting a pallet of crates; Zholdas with a clipboard counts the crates
